description.constant_value: Nightly scheduled autograder run (post-deadline grading batch)
Autograder that runs student submissions from GitHub and stores graded results in S3
Allows EventBridge to start the autograder CodeBuild project on schedule
CMK used to encrypt the autograder results bucket, CodeBuild logs, and grader credentials
Credentials used by the autograder (e.g. GitHub PAT for private repos or LMS API key)

github_repo_url.description: HTTPS clone URL of the GitHub repository holding the student submissions / grading harness.

github_source_version.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA of the student repository to check out and grade.

grader_credential.description: Optional credential value (e.g. GitHub PAT or LMS API key) to store in Secrets Manager. Leave empty to auto-generate a random grader token at apply time.

grading_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget (seconds) enforced on each student grading run inside the build.

language_runtime.description: Language runtime label passed to the grader scripts (e.g. python3.11).

log_retention_days.description: CloudWatch Logs retention (in days) for the CodeBuild build logs.

project_name.description: Short name used to prefix every autograder resource (also the CodeBuild project name).

results_retention_days.description: Days before graded results (and test reports) expire from the results bucket.

tags.description: Additional tags merged onto every resource.
